lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 5 horizontal rows and 8 vertical columns, localized posterior to the pectoral fin and gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the primary horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like matrix on the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with lighter pixels on the superior edge and darker pixels on the inferior edge.
